minecraft.dataSource: misode/mcmeta, pinned by version-summary tag (1.21.1-summary), never by branch

invariants.name: no hardcoded game values
invariants.diagnosis: A game value was inlined instead of read from the version registry. Minecraft identifiers are versioned data — an item that exists in 1.21.1 may not exist in another version, and a literal silently ships the wrong value. Legitimate exception: the bare 'minecraft:' namespace prefix being constructed by a serializer. Judge by whether a specific entity, item, or enchantment is named — 'minecraft:' alone is fine, 'minecraft:diamond_sword' is not.

invariants.name: no version-number comparisons
invariants.diagnosis: Serializers must branch on version traits, never on version numbers. A version-literal comparison breaks silently the moment a version is added: the 1.21.2 attribute rename and the 1.21.5 enchantments flattening did not land together, so no ordering of version numbers describes them. Branch on the trait flag instead.

invariants.name: no literal hex or px in components
invariants.diagnosis: Runtime theming works by overriding custom properties on the root element. An inlined value silently opts that element out of theming, and the breakage only appears in a non-default theme — not the one being looked at while the code is written. Every value has a named token, including the awkward ones (9px, 0.5px, 10px radius). If a value seems missing, add a token; do not inline or approximate.

generated.diagnosis: A non-empty diff means either src/data/generated was hand-edited, or a generator change was committed without its regenerated output. Both are bugs: the hand edit is destroyed on the next run and the underlying issue survives. Fix the generator, regenerate, and commit both together. Regeneration is deterministic — same mcmeta tag in, same bytes out — so a diff without a generator or version change means something else is wrong. Requires network: it fetches the pinned mcmeta tag. If offline, report this entry as skipped, not failed.

A non-empty diff means either src/styles/tokens.css was hand-edited, or tokens.source.json was refreshed without regenerating. Both are bugs, for the same reason as gen:commands. Unlike that generator, this one reads a committed local file — tokens.source.json — so it works offline and has no legitimate skip.
